desc:
Welcome to Aussie Anglers – the ultimate Australian fishing adventure on Roblox!

Explore Australia's rivers, estuaries, beaches, and offshore waters as you catch real Australian fish species. Build your collection, upgrade your gear, and discover rare trophy catches!

🐟 Catch iconic Australian fish, including:
• Flathead
• Bream
• Trevally
• Barramundi
• Jewfish (Mulloway)
• Bull Sharks
• And many more!

🎣 Features:
⭐ Realistic Australian fish species
🛥️ Explore unique Aussie fishing locations in your own tinny
🎣 Upgrade rods, reels, bait, and boats
🏆 Complete your Fish Log
💰 Sell your catches to earn cash
🌊 Discover rare and legendary fish
👥 Fish with friends and compete for the biggest catches!

Can you become Australia's greatest fisho?

👍 Like the game and ⭐ Favorite it for more updates!

Game is still in early developing stages please follow our socials to leave suggestions and keep updated.
